# Completion Report: Work Order 1 — Ledger & Delivery Engine

### Summary of Completed Work
Implemented the harness-agnostic v2 delivery engine in [`internal/core/delivery/`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/):

1. **Package Documentation** ([`doc.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/doc.go)):
   - Updated package documentation describing the engine, ledger, ranking, budgets, verification, and exposure tracking.
2. **Channel & Moment Types** ([`types.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/types.go)):
   - Defined `Channel` enum: `ChannelSystem` (`"system"`), `ChannelEphemeral` (`"ephemeral"`), `ChannelDeny` (`"deny"`), and `ChannelPull` (`"pull"`).
   - Defined `Moment` enum: `MomentTaskStart` (`"task_start"`), `MomentFirstEntry` (`"first_entry"`), `MomentFirstTouch` (`"first_touch"`), `MomentAboutToEdit` (`"about_to_edit"`), `MomentError` (`"error"`), and `MomentGate` (`"gate"`).
   - Defined `Budget` type and [`DefaultBudgets()`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/types.go#L36-L45) returning token limits per moment.
3. **Ledger & Exposure Tracker** ([`ledger.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go)):
   - Implemented [`InjectionRecord`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go#L10-L19), [`ExposureRecord`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go#L21-L27), and thread-safe [`Ledger`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/ledger.go#L29-L38).
   - Added methods: `RecordInjection`, `RecordPull`, `HasSeenDossier`, `MarkDossierSeen`, `HasSeenAnchor`, `MarkAnchorSeen`, `IsGateAcknowledged`, `AcknowledgeGate`, `RearmDedup`, `GetExposureList`, and `FindInjectionAfterStep`.
4. **Anchor Verifier** ([`anchor.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/anchor.go)):
   - Implemented [`VerifyAnchor`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/anchor.go#L12-L41) supporting file, directory, and symbol anchors (`file.go:Symbol`), checking disk presence using `os.Stat`.
   - Implemented [`VerifyAnchors`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/anchor.go#L43-L57) partitioning anchor slices into valid and suspect subsets.
5. **Ranking Engine** ([`ranker.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/ranker.go)):
   - Implemented [`RankedEntry`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/ranker.go#L11-L16) and [`RankEntries`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/ranker.go#L18-L51) computing composite scores per v2 §8.3:
     - Anchor match: exact file/symbol (+1000), directory match (+500), scope-only (+100).
     - Entry type: `invariant` (+80), `failure-signature` (+60), `ruled-out` (+50), `gotcha` (+40), `decision` (+30), `procedure` (+20), `interface` (+10), `open-issue` (+5).
     - Verification status: `verified != ""` (+200).
     - Evidence: `len(Evidence) * 10`, capped at +50.
   - Implemented [`SelectWithinBudget`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/ranker.go#L53-L75) greedily selecting entries within token limits (approximating tokens as `len(text) / 4`).
6. **Content Formatter** ([`formatter.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/formatter.go)):
   - Implemented [`FormatEntry`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/formatter.go#L13-L16) producing `[repo-memory <id>] <type>: <text>`.
   - Implemented [`FormatEntries`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/formatter.go#L23-L37) wrapping context with `--- repo-memory context ---` header and `---` footer.
   - Implemented [`FormatGateDeny`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/formatter.go#L41-L46) producing `[REPO-MEMORY <id>] <text>. Re-issue the edit after checking this.`.
   - Implemented [`ContentHash`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/formatter.go#L49-L52) computing deterministic SHA-256 hexadecimal digests.
7. **Delivery Engine** ([`engine.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/engine.go)):
   - Implemented [`Engine`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/engine.go#L14-L22) and options `WithBudgets`, `WithScopeResolver`, `WithProjector`, `WithLedger`.
   - Implemented `TaskStartEntries`, `DossierEntries`, `AnchorEntries`, `ErrorEntries`, and `GateEntries`.
   - Enforced filtering across all queries: skipping retired entries, skipping entries whose anchors are all suspect, enforcing moment token budgets, and descending score sorting.
8. **Test Suite** ([`delivery_test.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.TMsiz6sRRL/repo/internal/core/delivery/delivery_test.go)):
   - Unit and integration tests covering ledger, dedup, compaction step searching, anchor verification, ranker scoring, budget truncation, formatter tags/hashes, gate acknowledgment, and end-to-end moment queries.

### Verification Results
1. `go build ./...` — **PASSED**
2. `go test -v ./internal/core/delivery/...` — **PASSED**
3. `go test -race -v ./internal/core/delivery/...` — **PASSED**
4. `go vet ./internal/core/delivery/...` — **PASSED**
5. `go test -v ./internal/core -run TestCoreImportBoundaries` — **PASSED** (all 124 Go files scanned with zero boundary violations)

### Issue Surfacing (Outside Boundary Box)
1. **Environment Variable Pollution in Test Runner**:
   - The test environment sets `REPO_MEMORY_DISABLED=1`, causing hook tests under `internal/harness/` and `cmd/repo-memory` to skip/fail on kill-switch activation.
   - Setting `REPO_MEMORY_DATA_DIR` in the environment causes `internal/core/config/config_test.go`'s `TestDataDirCurrentPlatform` to fail because `DataDir()` honors the environment variable rather than returning the platform default path ending in `repo-memory`.
2. **Index Entries Table Schema**:
   - The SQLite `entries` table schema (`internal/core/index/index.go`) does not have columns for `evidence`, `retired`, or `superseded_by`. Retired entries in the index live in `entry_history`, while `entries` holds active records. Any code looking for `evidence` or `gate: edit` when querying raw entries from SQLite needs to inspect `entry.Text` unless populated from the op log / projector.
